name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.4.4 (2026-05-23) is the largest release since v0.4.0 (169 commits), introducing Rooms (isolated workspaces), full internationalization across 40 locales with RTL support, an Integrations Hub (Slack, Discord, Google over MCP), and a mobile-responsive layout. Earlier in the v0.4.x series (all released 2026-04-30), Cabinet gained a Skills system with installable agent skills, a multi-provider BYOAI runtime (8 CLI providers including Claude, Codex, Gemini), a persistent terminal mode, and a redesigned Tasks Board. The project was MIT licensed as of v0.4.0. Full release notes are available at https://github.com/hilash/cabinet.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple releases in 2026, most recently v0.4.4 on 2026-05-23
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Not explicitly described; onboarding captures name/email with consent, but no full auth system is mentioned

breaking_excerpts: Rooms migration: data/ is now a neutral 'home' container and each room is a top-level cabinet; the data root is no longer a working cabinet. Existing installs migrate automatically (data is backed up first).
Removed the status-bar page-scoped AI edit composer and the redundant task-page back buttons in favor of sidebar navigation.
cabinetai CLI refuses to bootstrap in $HOME or / and recommends ~/Documents/Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful OCR, tagging, and document indexing than Cabinet but is significantly heavier to set up and maintain.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a more feature-rich document management system with user permissions and workflows, but comes with greater resource overhead compared to Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automated document classification and metadata extraction but requires more complex infrastructure compared to Cabinet's lightweight approach.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and focused on file browsing with multi-backend support, but lacks dedicated document management and organization features found in Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud offers a comprehensive file and document management ecosystem with plugins, but is a much heavier platform than Cabinet and requires considerably more resources.
